contract.purpose: Keep SNARC injected memory context model-only so it is not persisted as user-authored transcript content.
contract.scope: Loop prompt assembly, transcript persistence, compaction input, export behavior, and SNARC capture boundaries.

invariants.invariant-1: Raw user prompt is the only text persisted as role=user.
invariants.invariant-2: SNARC memory context is visible to the model but absent from transcript export and user cards.
invariants.invariant-3: SNARC does not recapture its own injected context as a fresh user statement.
